messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas flagged that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the notifier is not their service. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]
- The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- There is a deploy freeze on the billing service from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- There is a deploy freeze on the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19]
- Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. [valid 2025-06-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2]
- INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]

    earlier: As of 2025-04-04, the notifier lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-04-04 to 2025-06-19; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]

- Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds. [decision; valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now. [valid 2025-01-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-10]
- As of 2026-05-25, Team Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. [decision; valid 2025-02-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-20]
- As of 2025-10-22, Farah is Team Dune's release captain for Q3 2025. [valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22-2]
- The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]

- On 2026-02-12, the Ember team reported that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
